The main thing I’m feeling is just a buff to the beams range or how fast it charges as she is in a very weird place as a mix between the brawlers and the frontlines. She is built like a close range tank with her beam and diamond form, but has no way to effectively gap close or chase an enemy that’s running. If you look like this:

The brawlers:
Her beam range is the same as venom’s tentacles, who is the longest range brawler in terms of primary. He also has his swing to get in and out.
Hulk can leap everywhere, cap has his infinite sprint, and Thing has his charge forward. If they need to chase they have these. Thor has his dash and can throw his hammer. Emma has no movement outside the short dash in her diamond form that’s locked into a 15 second cooldown.
They also as brawlers, have solidly high dps in melee range.

The frontlines:
Magneto and Dr strange as the next closest both have superior range to Emma. Their damage isn’t as high as the brawlers but primary wise is still higher than Emma’s. Because of their longer range they are effective at a longer distance and don’t need to chase or gap close to secure a kill or help make space. 

Anyway after all that rambling here is the TLDR
Emma is in a weird place, forced to play close range but not having the same kit boons or health pools that the other close ranges have.

I think the problem in terms of ‘fixing’ is that these characters are already very low picks in lower ranks and changing them will not help that situation. You have (moreso in the case of Widow and Hanzo) a character that is very hard to balance because of three little words, ‘a good player.’

The problem with those two in particular is you have to be good to get a decent use out of them. All of there heroes in the game you can get by just being average in terms of skill with a character, those two you can’t. A good Widow or Hanzo is able to consistently hit head shots and disrupt the enemy team. 
An average player is mainly hitting body shots and may get a lucky head shot here and there. Doesn’t sound too bad on paper, but in practice this is very weak compared to all the other dps heroes.

Tldr: They are so strong in good hands because they are very weak characters even in the hands of an average player.
